title: Kakeya sets and dimension compression in compact Lie groups
summary: We study two Kakeya set problems in compact semisimple Lie groups. In the first, motivated by the group structure, a Kakeya set is required to contain a left coset of every closed one-dimensional torus. For a compact semisimple Lie group $G$ of dimension $d$ and rank $r$, we determine the optimal Minkowski dimension for this problem, proving that it is exactly $(d+r)/2$. The upper bound is obtained from a Lie-theoretic construction associated with a Chevalley involution, while the lower bound combines incidence geometry with geometry of numbers.
